measurement_semantics.gradient_space: raw effective gradients before global-norm clipping and AdamW preconditioning
measurement_semantics.precision: BF16 autocast forward with FP32 losses/gradients as produced by the frozen training implementation
measurement_semantics.mechanism_batching: Four frozen mechanism rows share one forward; each objective is averaged over four independently computed row losses so the aggregate matches equal active-step row weighting.
measurement_semantics.consistency_batching: Use all epoch-1 consistency-active semantic rows in their frozen batch grouping; ordinary unlabeled companions are removed because they do not enter consistency loss.
measurement_semantics.cross_stream_caveat: C and H/prior never co-occur in one frozen optimizer batch. C-vs-prior cosine measures cross-step representation pressure and is sample-confounded, not simultaneous PCGrad-style conflict.
measurement_semantics.optimizer_caveat: Raw-gradient cosines do not include AdamW moment preconditioning or global-norm clipping.
